title: CI/CD 集成
markdown:
# CI/CD 集成 ## 核心概念 CI/CD 集成要做的事，是把本地跑得通的构建流程原样搬到服务器上，并在每次代码推送时自动重放：依赖安装 → 代码检查 → 类型检查 → 测试 → 构建 → 部署。构建工具链在其中是主体，而非周边——每一步的可靠性与耗时都直接决定流水线的质量。因此除了「能不能跑」，还要回答三个工程问题：依赖如何缓存以省去重复安装、任务如何并行以缩短总时长、密钥与环境变量如何安全注入。 --- ## 构建流水线在 CI/CD 中的角色 CI/CD（持续集成/持续部署）将开发者本地的构建流程自动化到服务器环境中。每当代码推送到仓库，CI 系统自动触发构建、检查、测试和部署流程。构建工具链在其中承担着核心角色——从代码检查到类型验证，从打包构建到产物部署，每一步都依赖构建工具链的可靠执行。 ```mermaid flowchart LR PUSH[代码推送] INSTALL[依赖安装] LINT[代码检查
ESLint + Stylelint] TYPE[类型检查
tsc --noEmit] TEST[单元测试
Vitest] BUILD[构建
Rsbuild/Vite] E2E[E2E 测试
Playwright] DEPLOY[部署
CDN/服务器] PUSH --> INSTALL --> LINT --> TYPE --> TEST --> BUILD --> E2E --> DEPLOY ``` --- ## GitHub Actions 配置 ### 基础 CI 流水线 ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci.yml name: CI on: push: branches: [main, develop] pull_request: branches: [main] concurrency: group: ci-${{ github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true jobs: ci: runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: node-version: [20, 22] steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup pnpm uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 with: version: 9 - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }} uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }} cache: pnpm - name: Install dependencies run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - name: Lint run: pnpm lint - name: Type check run: pnpm typecheck - name: Test run: pnpm test - name: Build run: pnpm build - name: Upload build artifacts if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: dist-${{ matrix.node-version }} path: dist/ retention-days: 7 ``` ### 部署流水线 ```yaml # .github/workflows/deploy.yml name: Deploy on: push: branches: [main] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 with: version: 9 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 22 cache: pnpm - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - run: pnpm build - name: Deploy to Vercel uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25 with: vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.ORG_ID }} vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.PROJECT_ID }} vercel-args: --prod working-directory: ./dist ``` --- ## CI 中的依赖缓存 依赖安装是 CI 中最耗时的步骤之一。正确的缓存策略可以将安装时间从分钟级缩短到秒级： ```yaml # pnpm 缓存策略 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 22 cache: pnpm # 或手动配置缓存 - name: Get pnpm store directory id: pnpm-cache shell: bash run: echo "STORE_PATH=$(pnpm store path)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT - uses: actions/cache@v4 with: path: ${{ steps.pnpm-cache.outputs.STORE_PATH }} key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }} restore-keys: | ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm- ``` --- ## 并行化 CI 任务 将独立的检查任务并行执行，缩短总体流水线时间： ```mermaid flowchart TD INSTALL[依赖安装] LINT[Lint] TYPE[Type Check] TEST[Unit Tests] BUILD[Build] E2E[E2E Tests] DEPLOY[Deploy] INSTALL --> LINT INSTALL --> TYPE INSTALL --> TEST LINT --> BUILD TYPE --> BUILD TEST --> BUILD BUILD --> E2E E2E --> DEPLOY ``` ```yaml jobs: lint: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: { node-version: 22, cache: pnpm } - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - run: pnpm lint typecheck: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: { node-version: 22, cache: pnpm } - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - run: pnpm typecheck test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: { node-version: 22, cache: pnpm } - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - run: pnpm test build: needs: [lint, typecheck, test] runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: { node-version: 22, cache: pnpm } - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - run: pnpm build ``` --- ## 环境变量与密钥管理 ```yaml jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest env: NODE_ENV: production VITE_API_URL: ${{ vars.API_URL }} steps: - run: pnpm build env: VITE_SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }} VITE_GA_ID: ${{ secrets.GA_ID }} ``` | 类型 | 存储位置 | 访问方式 | 适用范围 | | --------- | --------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------- | | Secrets | GitHub Settings → Secrets | `${{ secrets.NAME }}` | 密钥、Token | | Variables | GitHub Settings → Variables | `${{ vars.NAME }}` | 公开配置 | | Env | Workflow 文件中定义 | `${{ env.NAME }}` | 构建时配置 | --- ## 部署策略 ### 静态站点部署 ```mermaid flowchart LR BUILD[构建产物
dist/] --> S3[S3/OSS
对象存储] S3 --> CDN[CDN
全球分发] CDN --> USER[用户访问] ``` ### 容器化部署 ```dockerfile # Dockerfile FROM node:22-alpine AS builder WORKDIR /app RUN corepack enable pnpm COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./ RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile COPY . . RUN pnpm build FROM nginx:alpine COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf EXPOSE 80 CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"] ``` ### 版本化部署与回滚 ```yaml - name: Deploy with version tag run: | VERSION=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) aws s3 sync dist/ s3://my-bucket/releases/$VERSION/ aws s3 sync dist/ s3://my-bucket/latest/ ``` --- ## 小结 - CI/CD 将构建流程自动化：lint → typecheck → test → build → deploy。 - 依赖缓存（pnpm store cache）是 CI 性能优化的第一步。 - 独立任务并行执行（lint/typecheck/test 并行）缩短总体流水线时间。 - 环境变量通过 Secrets/Variables 安全管理，构建时注入。 - 部署策略包括静态站点（S3 + CDN）和容器化（Docker + Nginx）。 - 版本化部署支持快速回滚。
